evidenceType: REAL_OPENAI (recorded output, replayed in tests at $0)
instruction: When a client pays us through PayPal, accept it straight away if it's under $2,500 and in US dollars. If it's in another currency, or $2,500 or more, hold it and ask me first. If I reject it, mark it as rejected.

workflow.name: paypal_payment_review

nodes.label: Ask me
nodes.config_json: {"reason":"Review PayPal payment that is not in USD or is $2,500 or more.","amountRef":"trigger.amount"}

nodes.label: Needs review
nodes.config_json: {"outcome":"needs_review","message":"Could not verify the payment amount or currency."}

workflow.description: Auto-accept incoming PayPal payments only when they are USD and under $2,500; otherwise ask for approval.

assumptions: I treated the incoming payment as a PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED event.
I used the approval step for both non-USD payments and payments of $2,500 or more.
I interpreted “under $2,500” as strictly less than $2,500, so exactly $2,500 goes to approval.
No quoted or pasted instructions needed to be ignored.
output.interpretation: When a PayPal client payment arrives, automatically accept it only if it is in US dollars and under $2,500. If it is in any other currency or is $2,500 or more, hold it for my approval first. If I reject it, mark it as rejected.
